# Genesis Apocryphon Column 18 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Genesis Apocryphon Column 18 where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 18:1 — "went out" / "departed"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "went-out" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "went out" | Formal; echoes biblical language |
| PNEUMA | "departed" | Dynamic; more formal English |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS rendering "went out." This echoes the traditional biblical language of Abraham's departure.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 18:5 — "Go out from your land" / "Leave your homeland"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "go-out from-your-land" | Literal lekh lekha equivalent |
| LOGOS | "Go out from your land" | Formal; preserves biblical phrasing |
| PNEUMA | "Leave your homeland" | Dynamic; modern idiom |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS rendering. "Go out from your land" preserves the iconic phrasing of the divine call. PNEUMA's "homeland" is a modern concept that flattens the Aramaic.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 18:7 — "I shall make" / "I will make"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "I-shall-make-you a-great-nation" | Literal with hyphens |
| LOGOS | "I shall make of you a great nation" | Formal; "shall" for divine speech |
| PNEUMA | "I will make you into a great nation" | Dynamic; "will" for naturalness |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS rendering with "shall." In divine speech, "shall" carries the weight of sovereign decree and is the established convention in this project.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

*Total disagreements: 3*
*Resolution: LOGOS 3, EMET 0, PNEUMA 0, Compromise 0*
